subject.title: Multibulto FEDEX para consolidados pesados (prep-centers tipo ZoomBooks)

question: Should the work be split into staged PRs for recipient routing, FEDEX consolidated batch-skip state, and packing regeneration UI, or should maintainers sponsor one larger end-to-end PR?
rationale: The remaining work crosses data-driven routing, persisted label state, FEDEX side effects, and warehouse UI, so automation should not choose the rollout boundary or operator policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Split into staged PRs
options.body: Implement and validate the routing/config layer first, then add the batch-skip state and packing regeneration UX with focused operational proof.

options.title: One end-to-end PR
options.body: Land the full workflow together, accepting a larger review surface across core shipping logic and admin packing UI.

options.title: Defer the workflow
options.body: Keep the current manual Spring-to-FEDEX switch and consolidated label dedupe while operations continue handling prep-center shipments manually.

recommendation.title: Split into staged PRs
recommendation.body: Implement and validate the routing/config layer first, then add the batch-skip state and packing regeneration UX with focused operational proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history across carrier resolution and the FEDEX multi-box packing switch that this feature extends.
